summary: Configured node1 as DHCP server for node2 and node3 with a static reservation for node2 and dynamic pool for node3 then verified recovery after restarting all nodes
actions_performed: Converted node1 lan interface to static IP
Added dhcp host reservation for node2
Blocked platform DHCP server on clients using nftables
Rebooted all three nodes and verified recovery

evidence.summary: dnsmasq dhcp range and dhcp host generated and listening
